changes.description: Replace developer greeting with generic text and stock synthetic greeting; retain configurable assistant and user names.
Remove old deployed-entry migration from macOS development entry.
Disable old personal shopping/research/WeChat network transports and implicit old speech-service fallback; keep commercial adapters and protocol helpers.
Separate preview app identifiers, login item, install directory and startup log directory.
Use pinned public runtime/model metadata and checkout-local build cache; exclude model download cache metadata.
Remove developer-specific JD approval assertion; actual per-user capability verification remains authoritative.
Exclude private historical model trajectories and live paid/API acceptance scripts; explicitly skip the historical replay test.
Project-maintained code GPL-3.0-only; original third-party licenses preserved; services do not add software restrictions.

business_decisions: No replacement of model decisions with hardcoded recommendations or rankings.
